body:
## Summary

`src/chat/agent.ts:342` logs the effective API key at `warn` level on **every** `sendMessage`:
```ts
log.warn({ config: { model: effectiveModel, baseUrl: effectiveBaseUrl, apiKey: effectiveApiKey, apiMode: effectiveApiMode, ... } }, 'model used for request');
```
The key is written to the Trinno log channel (TRINNO_LOG_DIR, default output channel) in plaintext. Elsewhere the module is careful to strip secrets from the worker env (`SENSITIVE_ENV_PATTERNS`, agent.ts:116-153) — this log defeats that posture.

## Impact

Anyone reading logs (or a screenshot of the output channel shared in a bug report) gets a working API credential.

## Fix

Redact: `apiKey: effectiveApiKey ? '[redacted]' : ''` (or drop the field). Grep the rest of the log call sites for `apiKey` to confirm this is the only one.
title: SECURITY: full API key logged in plaintext on every chat request (agent.ts:342)
